Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: retention & deletion controls (SOC 2 / ISO)

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. As part of FinServe's SOC 2 and ISO readiness review we're consolidating evidence for retention and deletion controls that map to CC6 (log retention), CC11 (data disposal), and ISO 27001 A.8.3 / A.12.3 items. We want to be sure we understand how Redwood implements residency, retention, and deletion across Hosted and Private deployment modes.

Could you provide the following pieces of evidence and short answers where appropriate:
1) Authoritative retention policy(s) and date/version (we need the policy that governs customer data retention and deletion).
2) A configuration snapshot showing retention TTLs and lifecycle rules for object storage used by Hosted API (S3 buckets, bucket names masked is fine).
3) Audit logs showing a successful deletion event for a customer data deletion request (sample within last 90 days).
4) Description of backups/snapshots retention and how deletion is handled across backups (including RPO/RTO and deletion propagation).
5) Key management evidence: KMS key rotation policy and proof of key destruction for deleted datasets (if applicable).
6) Procedure for fulfilling data subject deletion requests, SLA for deletion, and evidence of executed runbook steps.
7) Any controls or options to pin data to a specific residency (region) and how retention settings are enforced per-region.

We're hoping to ingest these artifacts into our evidence tracker by Friday 8 May. If you can indicate what you can deliver and any items that will take longer, that would be helpful. If some items are redacted or staged (e.g., logs masked) that's acceptable as long as metadata and signatures remain intact.

Thank you — let me know if you need an NDA amendment or secure upload link.

Regards,
Aisha Kaur
Head of Security Operations
FinServe, Inc.

--

Thanks Rishi — tagging action items and owners so we don't miss anything. Below is the minimum evidence set that maps cleanly to SOC 2 and ISO items A.8/A.12:

1) Retention policy (owner: Legal/Product) — Redwood_Data_Retention_Policy_v2.pdf (versioned, includes retention classes and deletion SLA).
2) Retention config snapshot (owner: Infra) — retention-bucket-config-20260501.json (mask bucket ARNs).
3) Deletion execution log (owner: Infra) — deletion-run-YYYYMMDD.log (redacted, includes timestamps, job ids, operator id).
4) Backup retention description and snapshot evidence (owner: Infra/Platform) — narrative + backup-manifest-20260501.json.
5) KMS evidence (owner: Security/Infra) — key-rotation-policy.pdf + rotation audit entries (masked).
6) Runbook and DSAR workflow (owner: Legal/Security) — dsar_runbook_v1.docx and sample executed ticket id (redacted).
7) Signed index mapping redacted items to originals for auditor review (owner: Security).

Notes and controls:
- For Hosted API, customer data is stored in region selected at onboarding; we can provide region-specific retention snapshots.
- For Private deployments, data residency is customer-managed; we can provide the template policy we ship and the technical enforcement guidance.
- Deletion propagation to backups: we have scheduled snapshot pruning with a documented retention window; emergency secure deletion for legal holds is manual and will be documented with ticket evidence.

I'll prepare the SOC2-ISO_Evidence_Index.xlsx template and a short narrative mapping each artifact to SOC2/ISO control IDs. We'll redact PII and provide a signed hash of unredacted originals for auditor verification.

Neha
